observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black DSLR body with 'Nikon' logo and 'D7500' label visible on the front, body cap attached, no lens included.
Photo 1: Rear view showing LCD screen (appears off/blank), mode dial, button layout typical of a Nikon DSLR, resting on a printed cloth reading 'McSteve Online Gadget Store'.
Photo 2: Angled front-side view confirming 'Nikon D7500' text, hot-shoe mount visible, body cap still attached, strap attached.
No image shows the camera powered on, no shutter count, no sensor shown, no battery or charger, no memory card door, no accessories besides strap and body cap.
All photos are staged on the same branded cloth background, consistent with a reseller's catalog shot rather than a live functional test.

claims.evidence: No import sticker, UK retailer tag, or documentation visible in any photo.
No power-on, no live view, no shutter actuation, no sensor or lens-mount close-up shown; screen appears off in photo 1.
Photos 0-2 show only the body with a body cap, no lens attached, consistent with 'body only' claim.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be very high, reducing remaining mechanical life
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checker app or menu display
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-shutter-count / near end-of-life unit

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or fungus not visible without lens removed and test shot
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sensor with lens off, or a test photo showing no spots at small aperture

risks.risk: LCD screen functionality unknown; screen is off/blank in all photos
risks.proof: Photo or video of camera powered on showing live view on screen

risks.risk: Battery health and included accessories (battery, charger, strap, cap only) unclear
risks.proof: Photo of battery, charger, and any included accessories laid out together

risks.risk: Lens mount or autofocus motor condition cannot be verified without a lens attached and test
risks.proof: Video of lens mounted, autofocus engaging, and a focused test shot

risks.risk: Body cosmetic condition (scratches, dents, rubber grip wear) partially obscured by angle/lighting
risks.proof: Well-lit close-up photos of all sides including top and bottom plates
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavier cosmetic wear than shown

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on with shutter count visible via menu or app
Test photo taken with a lens attached, including a sensor-dust check shot
Photo of LCD screen actively displaying live view or playback
Photo of included battery, charger, and any other accessories
Close-up photos of top plate, bottom plate, and lens mount for cosmetic/corrosion check
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Nikon D7500 body from the visible badge in two photos, but no claim of functionality is demonstrated (screen off, no power-on, no shutter count), so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified-working body-only unit pending proof.
